evidence: The track is best walked or ridden as described below, from south to north.

From the car park on Kiwi Road a well-graded track follows the eastern side of Bartletts Ridge before crossing the head of Bartletts Creek and climbing to the Foster Creek– Bartletts Creek saddle, known as Foster’s Clearing.
A bridge crosses Doom Creek before a short climb up to the benched track that leads to the road end at Butchers Flat.

doubts: The Butchers Flat end is given as F2 (an unnamed track meeting Wakamarina Road), the only road end on the Havelock side; the text adds that vehicles must park at Butchers Flat carpark and walk to the track start, so the exact end point is a little uncertain. The Bartletts Valley access does not say where it joins the track. The mountain bike ride from Onamalutu Reserve to Canvastown (45 km) is a longer bike route, not recorded as a walking way. Deep Creek is where the Doom Track's water race led, not stated as reached by walkers.
